hint.text:
The Polynesian Islands are a group of islands in the Pacific Ocean to the east of Australia.

Missionaries are people who travel to other places to spread their religion.
hint.sound: ssml: The Polynesian Islands are a group of islands in the Pacific Ocean to the east of Australia. <break time='600ms'/> Missionaries are people who travel to other places to spread their religion.
hint.label: Glossary

atoms.text: Wave riding has been around for a long time, and has been around for the longest in the Polynesian Islands. However, people in West Africa and Peru have been wave riding for a long time as well. Surfing, as we know it today, grew out of wave riding and developed the most in Hawaii. In Hawaii, surfing was not just a hobby; it was a big part of the culture, and still is today! Many people would give offerings to trees before using their wood to make their surfboards. Surfing was called 'the sport of kings', but many kinds of people would surf. There were some people who did not like surfing, like some Christian missionaries, who thought that surfing was sinful. It wasn’t until 1904 that surfing became popular in other places. This was because George Freeth and Duke Kahanamoku, surfers from Hawaii, travelled to other places like California, Australia and New Zealand and gave surfing lessons. Now surfing is a popular sport all over the world!
